passages.text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and of Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Hosea.
Hosea was the son of Beeri.
The LORD gave His word to Hosea.
This happened during the time of several kings.
Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.
Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel at that time.
passages.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ הוֹשֵׁ֙עַ֙ בֶּן־ בְּאֵרִ֔י בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֥ה יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֛י יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Hosea for the first time.
Hosea was the son of Beeri.
The LORD gave Hosea a command.
The LORD said, “Go and marry a woman who is unfaithful.
Have children with her who will also be unfaithful.
The people in this land are unfaithful to the LORD.
They have turned away from the LORD.
They act like a wife who is unfaithful to her husband.”
passages.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבֶּר־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּהוֹשֵׁ֑עַ פ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לֵ֣ךְ קַח־ לְךָ֞ אֵ֤שֶׁת זְנוּנִים֙ וְיַלְדֵ֣י זְנוּנִ֔ים כִּֽי־ זָנֹ֤ה תִזְנֶה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵֽאַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
passages.sermon:
Hosea was a prophet.
God spoke to Hosea.
God told Hosea to marry a woman named Gomer.
Gomer was the daughter of Diblaim.
Hosea married Gomer.
Gomer became pregnant.
Gomer gave birth to a son for Hosea.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּקַּ֔ח אֶת־ גֹּ֖מֶר בַּת־ דִּבְלָ֑יִם וַתַּ֥הַר וַתֵּֽלֶד־ ל֖וֹ בֵּֽן׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Hosea, “Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Hosea.
The LORD told Hosea to name his son Jezreel.
The LORD said He would soon punish the house of Jehu for the bloodshed at Jezreel.
The LORD said He would end the kingdom of Israel.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל כִּי־ ע֣וֹד מְעַ֗ט וּפָ֨קַדְתִּ֜י אֶת־ דְּמֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יֵה֔וּא וְהִ֨שְׁבַּתִּ֔י מַמְלְכ֖וּת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Hosea.
God said what He would do in the future.
God said, “On that day, I will break the bow of Israel.
I will do this in the Valley of Jezreel.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־ קֶ֣שֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃

passages.text: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter, and the LORD said to Hosea, “Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.
passages.sermon:
Gomer was Hosea’s wife.
Gomer became pregnant again.
She gave birth to a daughter.
The LORD spoke to Hosea.
The LORD told Hosea to name the girl Lo-ruhamah.
Lo-ruhamah means “not pitied” or “no compassion.”
The LORD said He would not show compassion to the house of Israel.
The LORD said He would not forgive the house of Israel anymore.
passages.original: וַתַּ֤הַר עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בַּ֔ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ קְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אוֹסִ֜יף ע֗וֹד אֲרַחֵם֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ נָשֹׂ֥א אֶשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them—not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the LORD their God.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke about the house of Judah.
The LORD said He will have compassion on the house of Judah.
The LORD said He will save the house of Judah.
The LORD will save them by Himself, their God.
The LORD will not save them by bow.
The LORD will not save them by sword.
The LORD will not save them by war.
The LORD will not save them by horses.
The LORD will not save them by cavalry.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֲרַחֵ֔ם וְהֽוֹשַׁעְתִּ֖ים בַּיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֗ם בְּקֶ֤שֶׁת וּבְחֶ֙רֶב֙ וּבְמִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסוּסִ֖ים וּבְפָרָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.
passages.sermon:
Gomer was the wife of Hosea.
Gomer had a daughter named Lo-ruhamah.
Gomer finished nursing Lo-ruhamah.
Gomer became pregnant again.
Gomer gave birth to a son.
passages.original: וַתִּגְמֹ֖ל אֶת־ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃

passages.text: And the LORD said, “Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke.
The LORD gave a command about the child.
The LORD said, "Name him Lo-ammi."
Lo-ammi means "Not My People."
The LORD explained the name.
The LORD said, "You are not My people."
The LORD said, "I am not your God."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֑י כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹֽא־ אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the people of Israel.
God said the Israelites will be very many.
Their number will be like the sand by the sea.
No one can measure the sand by the sea.
No one can count the sand by the sea.
No one will be able to count the Israelites.
In the past, people said to them, “You are not my people.”
In that same place, people will call them, “Sons of the living God.”
passages.original: וְֽ֠הָיָה מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־ עַמִּ֣י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל־ חָֽי׃

passages.text: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
passages.sermon:
The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together.
They will gather as one group.
They will choose one leader for themselves.
They will leave the land together.
The day of Jezreel will be great.
passages.original: וְ֠נִקְבְּצוּ בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֤ה וּבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְעָל֣וּ מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
